name: NASA FIRMS Fire Information for Resource Management System
description: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) delivers near-real-time global active fire and thermal anomaly locations detected by the MODIS instruments (Terra and Aqua, 1 km) and VIIRS sensors (Suomi NPP and NOAA-20/21, 375 m). Processed within three hours of satellite overpass by NASA LANCE (Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS), FIRMS distributes point vector coordinates with Brightness Temperature, Fire Radiative Power (FRP), acquisition timestamp, satellite confidence score, and day/night flags.
